answer: Every attestation also sends a small ripple of reputation to peers, letting honest contributors compound trust over time, while fake accounts only dilute their own weight. Each agent must stake a bond and maintain a public thread of attested work; new identities start with zero history, so a sybil cluster gains nothing without paying real stake per identity. Like a lotus rooted in mud, verified provenance anchors the economy: forging N identities costs N bonds plus lost stake, making attacks economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0112's threat model.
